 Emma Watson suffers brutal fall outside splashy celebrity party at LA hot spot Chateau Marmont 
 By 
 Eric Todisco 
 Published 
 Nov. 13, 2026, 3:00 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Hermione down. 
 Emma Watson took a spill arriving at GQ’s 31st annual Men of the Year Party at Chateau Marmont in Los Angeles on Thursday night.
 The “Harry Potter” star, 36, tripped in her black-and-white striped heels on the steep pavement entrance to the star-studded event in photos obtained by Page Six.

 12

 However, Watson quickly recovered from the brutal fall and laughed it off in front of onlookers and photographers.
 She then headed into the party with a blond-haired male companion who was dressed in a structured black collarless jacket.

 Watson looked effortlessly chic for the night out, rocking a black minidress and colorfully embellished vintage Valentino coat.
 The British star paired her look with a gold chain necklace, hoop earrings and a black crossbody bag.

 The GQ party was hosted by Matt Damon, Andrew Garfield and Chris Rock, who were named the Leading Man of the Year, Performer of the Year and Auteur of the Year, respectively.
 The star-studded guest list included Cara Delevingne, Tinashe, Jimmy Kimmel, Monica Barbaro, Belmont Cameli, Ayo Edebiri, Don Cheadle, Jason Bateman, Patrick Schwarzenegger, Tracee Ellis Ross, Halle Bailey, Ice Spice, Jordan Chiles, Taylor Zakhar Perez and Benito Skinner. 
 Watson, unlike the other celebs, did not appear to pose on the red carpet.
 12 
 Watson (seen here in “Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets”) attended the event alongside stars like Jimmy Kimmel, Ayo Edebiri, Tracee Ellis Ross and Jason Bateman. Â©Warner Bros/courtesy Everett Co 
 12 
 Watson (seen here at Paris Fashion Week in October 2025) didn’t pose for photos on the red carpet at the GQ event. GC Images 
 Watson enjoyed a night out at the Chateau Marmont last month for the 2026 Academy Museum Gala after-party.
 She wore a black coat over a sparkling and lace black dress with a high slit, while her accessories included a silver bracelet and small gold earrings.
 Watson skipped the actual gala, which was attended by Taylor Swift, Kim Kardashian, Sabrina Carpenter, Demi Moore, Jacob Elordi, Kendall Jenner, Hailey Bieber and more A-listers.

 For both of her recent sightings, Watson wasn’t accompanied by her Mexican billionaire boyfriend, Gonzalo Hevia Baillères .
 The couple confirmed their romance in March by sharing a passionate smooch in a Mexican airport in photos obtained by Page Six. 
 Watson and Baillères, who comes from Mexico’s wealthiest families, were first linked in December 2025, when they were seen in Courchevel, France.
 12 
 Watson also went to a Miu Miu Dinner Party during Paris Fashion Week last October. Getty Images for Miu Miu 
 12 
 The actress (seen here in “Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1”) is relatively private about her personal life. Â©Warner Bros/Courtesy Everett Collection 
 Watson, who is notoriously private about her personal life, previously said she prefers dating people who aren’t familiar with her career.
 “It’s funny, occasionally people will apologize to me for the fact they’ve not seen my films. And I will be like, ‘Please don’t apologize. That is bliss to me,'” she said on Jay Shetty’s “On Purpose” podcast last September. 
 “I want people to appreciate my work, but I think knowing you don’t have to navigate that extra degree of weirdness is helpful, a relief.”
